cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(a) WHERE a.sectionId STARTS WITH '38.213' AND b.sectionId STARTS WITH '38.213' AND a.sectionId < b.sectionId RETURN a.sectionNumber AS sectionA, a.sectionTitle AS titleA, b.sectionNumber AS sectionB, b.sectionTitle AS titleB ORDER BY a.sectionId, b.sectionId LIMIT 20

question_en: Compare cross-section reference density across the TSs (how tightly each is internally linked).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(sec) AS secCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (src:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(tgt:Section) WHERE src.sectionId STARTS WITH ts WITH ts, secCnt, count(*) AS refCnt RETURN ts, secCnt, refCnt, round(toFloat(refCnt) / secCnt * 100) / 100 AS refDensity ORDER BY refDensity DESC

question_en: Find section pairs that reference each other (checking for circular dependencies).
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(a) WHERE a.sectionId < b.sectionId MATCH (a)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec) MATCH (b)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec) RETURN sp1.specNumber + '-' + a.sectionNumber AS sectionA, sp2.specNumber + '-' + b.sectionNumber AS sectionB ORDER BY a.sectionId, b.sectionId LIMIT 20

question_en: What does TS 38.214 Section 5.1 reach two hops out via references? (2-hop dependencies)
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(start:Section {sectionNumber:'5.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH start, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (start)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(mid:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(end:Section) MATCH (mid)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec) MATCH (end)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec) RETURN sp1.specNumber + '-' + mid.sectionNumber AS via, sp2.specNumber + '-' + end.sectionNumber AS target, end.sectionTitle LIMIT 20

question_en: How many CRs have been raised against TS 38.214? (how actively it is revised)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) RETURN count(cr) AS totalCR

question_en: List the 20 most recent CRs modifying TS 38.213 (recent changes).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, co.companyName, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, cr.tdocNumber LIMIT 20

question_en: Which CRs affect TS 38.214 Section 5.1? List CRs whose affected clauses include 5.1 (impact on my implementation).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected CONTAINS '5.1' MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, cr.clausesAffected, co.companyName, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, cr.tdocNumber LIMIT 15

question_en: Compare CR counts across the eight TSs (where standardization activity concentrates).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

question_en: List the CRs Qualcomm submitted against TS 38.214 (its areas of contribution).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) WHERE co.companyName CONTAINS 'Qualcomm' MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, cr.tdocNumber LIMIT 20

question_en: Which are the large CRs touching many clauses? List CRs affecting five or more sections of TS 38.214.
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND size(split(cr.clausesAffected, ',')) >= 5 RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, cr.clausesAffected, size(split(cr.clausesAffected, ',')) AS affectedCount ORDER BY affectedCount DESC, cr.tdocNumber LIMIT 20

question_en: Show the trend of TS 38.213 CR submissions per meeting (standardization-activity trend).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m.meetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingInt, count(cr) AS crCount RETURN meeting, crCount ORDER BY meetingInt

question_en: How many agreements approved CRs modifying TS 38.214? (how active decision-making is here)
cypher: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount

question_en: List the 10 most recent agreements affecting TS 38.213 (recent decisions).
cypher: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) MATCH (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT agr.resolutionId, COALESCE(agr.contentWithEquations, agr.content) AS content, m.meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, agr.resolutionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Summarize the number of agreements per TS (which spec sees the most consensus).
cypher: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] RETURN sp.specNumber, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount ORDER BY agrCount DESC

question_en: Which TS 38.213 agreements still carry a TBD? (technical issues not yet settled)
cypher: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) WHERE agr.hasTBD = true MATCH (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT agr.resolutionId, COALESCE(agr.contentWithEquations, agr.content) AS content, m.meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Are there agreements that reference CRs across multiple TSs at once? (cross-TS decisions)
cypher: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215'] WITH agr, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS specs WHERE size(specs) > 1 MATCH (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN agr.resolutionId, specs, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, agr.resolutionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Which TS 38.213 resolutions mention HARQ? (tracing HARQ-related decisions)
cypher: MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) WHERE COALESCE(res.contentWithEquations, res.content, '') =~ '(?i).*HARQ.*' MATCH (res)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN [lbl IN ['Resolution','Agreement','Conclusion','WorkingAssumption'] WHERE lbl IN labels(res)] AS type, res.resolutionId, COALESCE(res.contentWithEquations, res.content) AS content, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, res.resolutionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Which TSs define antenna-related sections? (locating specs for antenna-port implementation)
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*antenna.*' RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, sec.level ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber

question_en: List the CSI-related tables (parameter tables for CSI-reporting implementation).
cypher: MATCH (tbl:TSTable) WHERE tbl.tableCaption =~ '(?i).*CSI.*' MATCH (tbl)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber, tbl.tableNumber, tbl.tableCaption, sec.sectionNumber ORDER BY sp.specNumber, tbl.tableNumber LIMIT 20

question_en: How are HARQ-related sections distributed across the TSs? (scope of HARQ implementation)
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*HARQ.*' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(sec) AS sectionCount, collect(sec.sectionNumber) AS sections ORDER BY sectionCount DESC

question_en: Show the PDCCH-related sections and tables (full scope for control-channel implementation).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*PDCCH.*' OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, sec.level, collect(tbl.tableNumber) AS tables ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber

question_en: Show the PUSCH-related sections and tables (scope for uplink data-channel implementation).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*PUSCH.*' OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, collect(tbl.tableNumber) AS tables ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber

question_en: Show the SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) sections and tables (specs for SRS implementation).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*SRS.*' OR sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*sounding.*' OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, collect(tbl.tableNumber) AS tables ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber

question_en: Which sections mention measurement or reporting? (scope for measurement-reporting implementation)
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*(measurement|reporting).*' RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber LIMIT 20

question_en: Compare the top 5 TSs by CR count against their section counts (complexity vs. change frequency).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec {specNumber: ts}) RETURN ts, crCount, count(sec) AS sectionCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

question_en: Rank companies by total CRs submitted across the eight TSs (who the major players are).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.201','38.202','38.291'] MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN co.companyName, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 15

question_en: Return the top 10 most-referenced sections and how many CRs modified each (stability of core sections).
cypher: MATCH (tgt:Section)<-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]-(src:Section) WITH tgt, count(src) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (tgt)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected CONTAINS tgt.sectionNumber RETURN sp.specNumber, tgt.sectionNumber, tgt.sectionTitle, refCount, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY refCount DESC

question_en: Which companies submitted the most CRs modifying TS 38.214? Top 10 (technical leadership in this spec).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN co.companyName, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Compare CR counts against agreement counts per TS (which spec changes most relative to consensus).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215'] WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr2:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp2:Spec) WHERE sp2.specNumber = ts RETURN ts, crCnt, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCnt ORDER BY crCnt DESC

question_en: Which sections contain five or more tables? (parameter-dense implementation points)
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) WITH sec, count(tbl) AS tableCount WHERE tableCount >= 5 MATCH (sec)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, tableCount ORDER BY tableCount DESC LIMIT 15

question_en: Which are the top 10 areas rich in both sections and tables? (high implementation difficulty)
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) WITH sec, count(tbl) AS tableCount WHERE tableCount >= 3 MATCH (sec)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(sub:Section) RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle, tableCount, count(sub) AS subSectionCount ORDER BY tableCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Summarize the graph: node and relationship counts by type (overall graph scale).
cypher: CALL { MATCH (n:Section) RETURN 'Section' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:TSTable) RETURN 'TSTable' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:TSFigure) RETURN 'TSFigure' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:Spec) RETURN 'Spec' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:CR) RETURN 'CR' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:Meeting) RETURN 'Meeting' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:Company) RETURN 'Company' AS label, count(n) AS cnt UNION ALL MATCH (n:Resolution) RETURN 'Resolution' AS label, count(n) AS cnt } RETURN label, cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

question_en: List the TSs modified by CRs under Work Item NR_newRAT-Core (portfolio impact of this work item).
cypher: MATCH (w:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'})<-[:RELATED_TO]-(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber AS spec, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

question_en: Which TSs did resolutions on NR_FeMIMO-Core CRs land in? (how this work item's decisions entered the standard)
cypher: MATCH (w:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_FeMIMO-Core'})<-[:RELATED_TO]-(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr) RETURN sp.specNumber AS spec, count(DISTINCT res) AS resolutionCount, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC

question_en: Return the item-level node count for each of the five entity classes: RRCParameter, CapabilityItem, Procedure, PerformanceRequirement, ConformanceTest (entity-layer inventory).
cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest'])   AND n.granularity = 'item' RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        count(n) AS items ORDER BY items DESC

question_en: Are all item-level entity nodes linked to a Section via :definedInSection? (grounding-coverage check)
cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest'])   AND n.granularity = 'item' WITH n, exists((n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section)) AS linked RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        count(n) AS total,        sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked,        round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(n), 1) AS link_pct

question_en: Do the disjointWith relations between Features (LTM, CHO, CPC, CPAC, etc.) match the feature catalog's disjoint groups? (consistency check)
cypher: MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]->(b:Feature) WHERE a.name < b.name RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b ORDER BY a, b

question_en: What is the granularity-property distribution across the five entity classes? (item-level vs. section-level)
cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        coalesce(n.granularity, '<unset>') AS granularity,        count(n) AS c ORDER BY class, granularity

question_en: Do the baseline IEs (CodebookConfig-r16, LTM-Config-r18, BeamFailureRecoveryConfig, TCI-State) exist as :RRCParameter nodes? (baseline-presence check)
cypher: UNWIND ['CodebookConfig-r16','LTM-Config-r18','BeamFailureRecoveryConfig','TCI-State','TCI-UL-State-r17','RadioLinkMonitoringConfig'] AS expected OPTIONAL MATCH (ie:RRCParameter {ieName: expected}) RETURN expected, ie IS NOT NULL AS found, ie.specNumber AS spec, ie.release AS release

question_en: Are all 22 features from the feature catalog loaded as :Feature nodes? (feature-catalog parity check)
cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) RETURN count(f) AS feature_count, collect(f.featureId)[..30] AS feature_ids ORDER BY feature_count DESC

question_en: What is the summary-of-change of CR R1-2506685, introducing the Rel-19 UL Tx switching 3Tx UE scenario?
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: 'R1-2506685'}) WHERE cr.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.summaryOfChange

question_en: What happens if the CRs under Work Item NR_LPWUS-Core (Rel-19 LP-WUS/WUR) are not approved? (consequences-if-not-approved)

question_en: List the five specs CR R1-2504971 affects and the impact type (Core/Test/OM) for each.
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: 'R1-2504971'})-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, type(r) AS relationType ORDER BY sp.specNumber ASC

question_en: Which other specs do CRs modifying TS 38.214 most often ripple into, and how many CRs each?
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(mainSpec:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(otherSpec:Spec) WHERE mainSpec <> otherSpec RETURN mainSpec.specNumber AS modifiedSpec, otherSpec.specNumber AS affectedSpec, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

question_en: How many CRs list TS 38.214 as a cross-spec impact target, and which are representative?
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WITH sp, collect(cr.tdocNumber) AS crList, count(cr) AS crCount RETURN sp.specNumber, crCount, crList[..10] AS sampleCRs

question_en: Which 10 CRs have the widest cross-spec reach, and which specs does each affect?
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, count(DISTINCT sp) AS affectedSpecCount, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS affectedSpecs ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC, cr.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the CRs in CR pack RP-252634 (submitted to the latest plenary RAN#109), with each CR's summary-of-change.

question_en: Into which CR packs were the CRs of Work Item NR_newRAT-Core (initial NR spec) bundled for TSG submission?
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}) MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack) RETURN wi.workItemCode, pack.crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY pack.tsgMeeting DESC, crCount DESC LIMIT 15

question_en: List the CR packs submitted to plenary RAN#109 and the CR count in each.
cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(cr:CR) WHERE pack.tsgMeeting = 'RAN#109' RETURN pack.tsgMeeting, pack.crPackId, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

question_en: What patterns run through the reason-for-change of recent CRs modifying TS 38.214 Section 5.1.5 (PDSCH MIMO, the most-revised section)?

question_en: For the CRs approved by resolution AGR-115-7.1-004, give the reason-for-change and summary-of-change.

question_en: List every TS section changed by CRs under Work Item NR_MIMO_evo_DL_UL-Core (NR MIMO Evolution), with each change's reason.

question_en: For Samsung's recent CRs with cross-spec impact, what is the distribution of affected specs? (latest first)

question_en: Summarize the changes across the CRs agreed at meeting RAN1#121 (consolidated summary-of-change).

question_en: List every TR that affected TS 38.211 and its impact type (revision history of 38.211).

question_en: List the TR studies that spawned an entirely new TS, with the resulting TS number (origins of new specs).

question_en: Which TS sections did the RedCap (Reduced Capability) study TR 38.875 affect? (low-power IoT reference)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.875'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ti.impactType, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

question_en: Which new sections did the LP-WUS (Low-Power Wake-Up Signal) study TR 38.869 add to TS 38.211 and 38.213? (UE power-saving implementation)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.869'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, ti.affectedSection, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

question_en: What impact did the URLLC study TR 38.824 have on TS 38.211 and 38.214, in detail? (low-latency industrial comms)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.824'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, sp.specNumber, ti.impactType, ti.affectedSection, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY sp.specNumber

question_en: List the TR studies targeting Rel-18 and the type of impact each had on the TSs.
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus, ti.impactType, sp.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Return the current status and scope of the 6G Radio study TR 38.760-1 (next-generation roadmap review).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.760-1'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus, tr.trVersion, tr.scope

question_en: Return the conclusions of TR 38.808 (52.6-71 GHz band) and how they were reflected into the TSs (mmWave product planning).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.808'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus, tr.conclusions, ti.impactType, sp.specNumber

question_en: List the other TRs referenced by TR 38.859 (Ambient IoT for NR) (surveying related studies).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.859'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber

question_en: List the TRs that reference TR 38.802 (RedCap) (reverse lookup, tracing follow-on studies).

question_en: Which are the top 5 most-referenced TRs? (identifying foundational studies)
cypher: MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)<-[:REFERENCES_TR]-(src:TechnicalReport) WITH ref, count(src) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC, ref.trNumber LIMIT 5 RETURN ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle, refCount

question_en: List the TDocs at meeting RAN2#130 linked to Work Item NR_Mob_enh2-Core (mobility-enhancement meeting prep).

question_en: List the TDocs under Agenda Item 6.1.3.1 (NR RRC) at meeting RAN2#132 (RRC agenda scan).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '6.1.3.1'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the TDocs submitted by Huawei at meeting RAN2#132 (competitor contribution review).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the most recently submitted TDocs targeting Rel-19 (latest Rel-19 activity).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the TDocs approved or agreed at meeting RAN2#131 (meeting outcome review).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#131'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.status IN ['approved', 'agreed'] RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: Return the decision status of TDoc R2-2509337 (outcome lookup).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, t.type LIMIT 1

question_en: Return the intended purpose (the 'For' field) of TDoc R2-2509337 (contribution intent).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.`for` LIMIT 1

question_en: Return the contact person for TDoc R2-2509337 (author follow-up).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'})-[:HAS_CONTACT]->(c:Contact) RETURN t.tdocNumber, c.contactName, c.contactId LIMIT 1

question_en: List all agenda items and their descriptions for meeting RAN2#132 (agenda overview).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem) WITH DISTINCT a RETURN a.agendaNumber, a.agendaDescription ORDER BY a.agendaNumber ASC LIMIT 50

question_en: Return the predecessor and successor revisions of TDoc R2-2509478 (revision-lineage tracing).

question_en: Which incoming LS does a given TDoc reply to (reply-to linkage)?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:REPLY_TO]->(target:Tdoc) RETURN t.tdocNumber, target.tdocNumber AS replyTarget ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which spec does CR R2-2509337 modify (change target)?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'})-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, s.specNumber, s.specVersion LIMIT 1

question_en: Return the change category and affected scope of CR R2-2509337 (impact assessment).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.crCategory, t.clausesAffected, t.affectsUICC, t.affectsME, t.affectsRAN, t.affectsCN LIMIT 1

question_en: List the TDocs postponed to a later meeting at RAN2#131 (deferred-item tracking).

question_en: List the incoming liaison statements at meeting RAN2#132 with their agenda items (incoming-LS triage).

question_en: List Ericsson's contributions to Work Item NR_newRAT-Core (competitor positioning).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Ericsson'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: List all companies' contributions under Agenda Item 8.2.2 (Ambient IoT) at RAN2#130 (A-IoT landscape).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#130'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.2.2'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status ORDER BY c.companyName, t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

question_en: Count the contributions per company for Work Item NR_newRAT-Core (participation ranking).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}) RETURN c.companyName, count(t) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Return Samsung's contribution adoption rate (success-rate benchmarking).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) WITH count(t) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN t.status IN ['agreed', 'approved', 'endorsed'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adopted RETURN total, adopted, round(adopted * 100.0 / total, 1) AS adoptionRate

question_en: List other companies' TDocs under the same agenda item as R2-2509337 (competing-proposal scan).
cypher: MATCH (t0:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'})-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem), (t0)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) MATCH (m)<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE t.tdocNumber <> 'R2-2509337' RETURN c.companyName, t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status ORDER BY c.companyName, t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

question_en: Return Nokia's contribution distribution across work items (focus-area profiling).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Nokia'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) RETURN wi.workItemCode, count(t) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: List Samsung's contributions to Work Item NR_Mob_enh2-Core across earlier meetings (contribution history).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_Mob_enh2-Core'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: Summarize the outcomes of Samsung's contributions at RAN2#132 (meeting result summary).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) RETURN t.status, count(t) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

question_en: List the not-treated TDocs under Agenda Item 11.4.2 at RAN2#107 (pending-item backlog).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#107'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '11.4.2'}) WHERE t.status = 'not treated' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the agreements reached at meeting RAN2#117 (decision review).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#117'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, ai.agendaNumber ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, a.sequence LIMIT 15

question_en: List the conclusions drawn at meeting RAN2#121 (study-outcome review).
cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content, c.hasConsensus ORDER BY c.sequence LIMIT 10

question_en: List the working assumptions from meeting RAN2#115 (provisional-decision review).
cypher: MATCH (wa:WorkingAssumption)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#115'}) RETURN wa.resolutionId, wa.content ORDER BY wa.sequence LIMIT 15

question_en: List the resolutions under Agenda Item 8.11 at RAN2#117 (agenda decision trace).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE (ai.agendaNumber = '8.11' OR ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '8.11.') AND ai.meetingNumber = '117' MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, r.content ORDER BY r.sequence LIMIT 15

question_en: List the resolutions related to Rel-18 (release decision review).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.sequence LIMIT 10

question_en: List the resolutions that drive changes to spec 38.331 (RRC decision impact).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.resolutionId LIMIT 10

question_en: List the resolutions tied to a given work item via its TDocs (work-item decision trace).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH wi, r, m RETURN wi.workItemCode AS workItemId, r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, wi.workItemCode, r.resolutionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Return the top 10 agenda items by resolution count (hot-topic ranking).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber <> 'UNKNOWN' RETURN ai.agendaNumber, ai.meetingNumber, count(r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC, ai.agendaNumber, ai.meetingNumber LIMIT 10

question_en: Which resolutions did TDoc R2-2508373 lead to (contribution-to-decision trace)?
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WHERE 'R2-2508373' IN t.tdocNumber MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content

question_en: List the TDocs referenced by Agreement AGR-132-8.13-005 (decision provenance).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement {resolutionId: 'AGR-132-8.13-005'})-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, t.tdocNumber, t.title

question_en: List the agreements flagging items for comeback (deferred-decision tracking).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'comeback' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which specs were updated by agreed TDocs at RAN2#132 (spec-change trace)?
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY a.sequence, t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Return the share of Huawei's TDocs that led to resolutions (effectiveness rate).
cypher: MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS totalTdocs MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc)<-[:REFERENCES]-(r:Resolution) WITH totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT t) AS resolvedTdocs RETURN totalTdocs, resolvedTdocs, round(100.0 * resolvedTdocs / totalTdocs, 1) AS ratio

question_en: Rank the main contributors to spec 38.331 (RRC ownership).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Return the top companies by resolution contribution per work item (technology leadership).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi, c, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC WITH wi, collect({company: c.companyName, count: cnt})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN wi.workItemCode, topCompanies ORDER BY wi.workItemCode LIMIT 5

question_en: Compare resolution contributions between Huawei and Ericsson (head-to-head).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE c.companyName IN ['Huawei', 'Ericsson'] RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC

question_en: Return the trend of Rel-18 resolution counts over meetings (chronological trend).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt, count(r) AS resCount ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt ASC

question_en: Track how Huawei's resolution-contribution rate changed over meetings (influence trend).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m, count(r) AS total MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}), (r2)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH m, total, count(DISTINCT r2) AS huaweiCount RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt, huaweiCount, total, round(100.0 * huaweiCount / total, 1) AS ratio ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt ASC

question_en: Return the total counts by resolution type (Agreement / Conclusion / WorkingAssumption) (decision mix).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

question_en: Return resolution counts by type at meeting RAN2#132 (meeting decision mix).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'}) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

question_en: Which resolutions did TDoc R2-2500064 lead to (contribution-to-decision trace)?
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2500064'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content

question_en: List the agreements containing open FFS items (further-study backlog).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'FFS' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Rank the top 10 companies by resolution-referenced TDocs (overall influence).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Return the trend of agreement counts per meeting (activity trend).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt, count(a) AS agrCount ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt ASC

question_en: Return the trend of conclusion counts per meeting (study-closure trend).
cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt, count(c) AS conCount ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt ASC

question_en: List all sections of spec 38.331 (RRC structure overview).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle, s.level ORDER BY s.sectionNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: List the subsections under section 5 of spec 38.321 (MAC structure drill-down).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(parent:Section {sectionNumber:'5'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH parent, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (parent)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(child:Section) RETURN child.sectionId, child.sectionNumber, child.sectionTitle ORDER BY child.sectionNumber

question_en: Return the ancestor path of section 5.3.5 in spec 38.331 (breadcrumb location).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'5.3.5'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH path = (s)-[:PARENT_SECTION*]->(ancestor:Section) RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.sectionId] AS breadcrumb

question_en: List the level-1 sections of spec 38.321 (top-level MAC outline).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section {level: 1})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.321'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber

question_en: List the tables in section 6.2.1 of spec 38.321 (table lookup).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'6.2.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption

question_en: List the figures in section 6.1.3.1 of spec 38.321 (figure lookup).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'6.1.3.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:CONTAINS_FIGURE]->(f:TSFigure) RETURN f.figureId, f.figureNumber, f.figureCaption

question_en: Which section contains Table 5.1-1 (table location)?
cypher: MATCH (t:TSTable)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(s:Section) WHERE t.tableNumber = '5.1-1' RETURN t.tableId, s.sectionId, s.sectionTitle

question_en: List all tables in spec 38.331 (table inventory).
cypher: MATCH (t:TSTable)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY t.tableNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: List the sections whose title contains 'MAC' (topic search).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section) WHERE s.sectionTitle CONTAINS 'MAC' RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionId LIMIT 25

question_en: Find the spec and section that hold Table 6.3.3-1 (reverse table lookup).
cypher: MATCH (t:TSTable {tableNumber: '6.3.3-1'})-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber, s.sectionId, t.tableId

question_en: List the sections referenced by section 5.4.4 of spec 38.321 (outgoing references).

question_en: Return the reason for change of CR R2-2508534 (change rationale).

gold_primary_values:
RAN1 agreed that “After initial cell selection, the UE is expected to find a single SCS per frequency layer” in RAN1#90 meeting and informed RAN2 in LS (R2-1815956). 
According to RAN1 agreements, the single SCS per frequency restriction is applicable for both CONNECTED and IDLE/INACTIVE state.  

For CONNECTED state, RAN2 reflected the single SCS per frequency layer restriction in MO configuration and captured it in section 5.5.2.1 in RRC. 
-	to ensure that all measurement objects configured in this specification and in TS 36.331 [10] with the same ssbFrequency have the same ssbSubcarrierSpacing;
But there is no clarification of this restriction for IDLE/INACTIVE state. 
For IDLE/INACTIVE state, network can provide the frequency and SCS information in SIB4, SIB11, or in RRCRelease with measIdleConfig message. 
If there is no clarification on the single SCS per frequency layer restriction in IDLE/INACTIVE state, it’s not clear whether the restriction is applicable across all the IDLE/INACTIVE configuration across different kind of configurations.

gold_primary_values:
Add the single SCS per frequency layer restriction in general in Clause 9.2.4 Measurements, and it’s applicable for RRC_IDLE state, RRC_INACTIVE state and RRC_CONNECTED state.  

Impact Analysis
Impacted 5G architecture options: 
NR SA, NR-DC, NE-DC, EN-DC
 
Impacted functionality: 
Inter-frequency cell re-selection
 
Inter-operability: 
If the network is implemented according to the CR and the UE is not, there is no inter-operability issue.
If the UE is implemented according to the CR and the network is not, the UE may consider the network configuration is incorrect.

question_en: List the top 5 most-referenced TRs (most-cited studies).
cypher: MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport) WITH tr, count(ref) AS refCount RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC, tr.trNumber LIMIT 5

question_en: List the TDocs presented at meeting RAN5#109 (meeting document survey).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber:'RAN5#109'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title ORDER BY t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

question_en: Show the details of a CR (R5-255xxx) and the spec it modifies (change-request lookup).

question_en: Which five meetings hosted the most TDocs? (activity ranking)

question_en: List Samsung's TDocs, newest first (contributor tracking).

question_en: How many TDocs target Rel-18? (release volume check)

question_en: List the CRs that modify TS 38.533 (spec-change tracking).

question_en: Which five Work Items have the most TDocs? (work-item activity)
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) RETURN wi.workItemCode, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: Which ten agenda items drew the most TDocs? (agenda workload)

question_en: Which ten companies submitted the most CRs? (contribution ranking)

question_en: Trace the revision chain of a TDoc (R5-255xxx) (revision-lineage tracing).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:IS_REVISION_OF*1..3]->(prev:Tdoc) WHERE t.tdocNumber STARTS WITH 'R5-255' RETURN t.tdocNumber, collect(prev.tdocNumber) AS chain ORDER BY t.tdocNumber LIMIT 5

question_en: For each liaison statement (LS), show its direction and recipient working groups (LS routing analysis).
cypher: MATCH (ls:LS) OPTIONAL MATCH (ls)-[:SENT_TO]->(wg:WorkingGroup) RETURN ls.tdocNumber, ls.direction, collect(wg.wgName) AS sentTo ORDER BY ls.tdocNumber, ls.direction LIMIT 5

question_en: Report node counts by label across the graph (dataset overview).
cypher: MATCH (n) UNWIND labels(n) AS label RETURN label, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, label

question_en: Show TDoc counts per meeting, most recent first (coverage check).
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting) WITH m OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m) WITH m, count(t) AS tdocs RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, tdocs ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: How many TDocs have a submitting company recorded? (attribution coverage)

question_en: Break down TDocs by target release (release distribution).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release) RETURN r.releaseName, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which ten specs receive the most CRs? (spec churn ranking)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: How many TDocs were presented at meeting RAN5#109? (meeting volume)
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber:'RAN5#109'}) RETURN count(t) AS cnt

question_en: How many meetings are in the dataset? (corpus size)
cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting) RETURN count(m) AS cnt

question_en: Compare the total TDoc count against the CR count (CR proportion).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS total MATCH (cr:CR) RETURN total, count(cr) AS crs

question_en: How many liaison statements (LS) are recorded? (LS count)
cypher: MATCH (ls:LS) RETURN count(ls) AS cnt

question_en: How many Contact nodes exist? (contact count)
cypher: MATCH (c:Contact) RETURN count(c) AS cnt

question_en: How many agenda items are recorded? (agenda count)
cypher: MATCH (ai:AgendaItem) RETURN count(ai) AS cnt

question_en: How many Work Items are recorded? (work-item count)
cypher: MATCH (wi:WorkItem) RETURN count(wi) AS cnt

question_en: List the conclusions reached at meeting RAN5#81 (meeting-outcome review).
cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN5#81'}) RETURN c.resolutionId AS id, c.content AS content, c.hasConsensus AS consensus ORDER BY c.sequence LIMIT 10

question_en: Show the number of resolutions per agenda item (agenda-outcome breakdown).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WITH ai.agendaNumber AS agenda, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN agenda, cnt

question_en: How many resolutions relate to each release? (release-outcome breakdown)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release) WHERE rel.releaseName STARTS WITH 'Rel-' WITH rel.releaseName AS release, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN release, cnt

question_en: How many resolutions touch each modified spec? (spec-outcome breakdown)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) WITH s.specNumber AS spec, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN spec, cnt

question_en: How many resolutions relate to each Work Item? (work-item outcome breakdown)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) WITH wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, wi_id LIMIT 10 RETURN wi_id, cnt

question_en: Which ten agenda items yielded the most resolutions? (busiest-agenda ranking)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WITH ai.agendaNumber AS agenda, ai.meetingNumber AS meeting, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, agenda, meeting LIMIT 10 RETURN agenda, meeting, cnt

question_en: Which TDocs are referenced by two or more resolutions? (frequently-cited documents)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WITH t.tdocNumber AS tdoc, count(r) AS ref_count WHERE ref_count >= 2 RETURN tdoc, ref_count ORDER BY ref_count DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: For each resolution, list the TDocs it references (resolution-to-document mapping).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WITH r.resolutionId AS rid, collect(t.tdocNumber) AS tdocs, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, rid LIMIT 10 RETURN rid, cnt, tdocs[..5] AS sample_tdocs

question_en: Which specs does each referenced TDoc end up modifying? (document-to-spec impact)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) WITH t.tdocNumber AS tdoc, collect(DISTINCT s.specNumber) AS specs, count(DISTINCT s) AS spec_count ORDER BY spec_count DESC, tdoc LIMIT 10 RETURN tdoc, spec_count, specs[..5] AS sample_specs

question_en: Which ten companies submitted the most resolution-referenced TDocs? (influence ranking)
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolution_count ORDER BY resolution_count DESC, company LIMIT 10 RETURN company, resolution_count

question_en: Show each company's resolution contributions per Work Item (technology contribution breakdown).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN wi_id, company, cnt

question_en: Rank the main contributors to each spec's resolutions (spec contributor ranking).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH s.specNumber AS spec, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT t) AS tdoc_count ORDER BY tdoc_count DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN spec, company, tdoc_count

question_en: Compare Samsung and Qualcomm by resolution contribution (head-to-head comparison).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE c.companyName IN ['Samsung', 'Qualcomm'] WITH c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt RETURN company, cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

question_en: Track resolution counts across meetings over time (resolution trend).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS num, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY num ASC RETURN meeting, cnt

question_en: Track Samsung's resolution contributions across meetings over time (contribution trend).
cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS num, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY num ASC RETURN meeting, cnt

question_en: List the sections of TS 38.533 (structure browsing).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle, s.level ORDER BY s.sectionNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: List the subsections under section 5 of TS 38.533 (drilling into a clause).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.533'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(p:Section {sectionNumber:'5'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH p,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(c:Section) RETURN c.sectionId, c.sectionNumber, c.sectionTitle ORDER BY c.sectionNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: Return the ancestor path of section 6.2.1 in TS 38.521-1 (locating a clause in the hierarchy).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.521-1'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(sec:Section {sectionNumber:'6.2.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH sec,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH path = (sec)-[:PARENT_SECTION*]->(ancestor:Section) RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.sectionId] AS hierarchy

question_en: List the level-1 sections of TS 38.533 (top-level outline).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section {level: 1})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber

question_en: List the tables in section 6.2.3 of TS 38.521-1 (table lookup).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.521-1'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(sec:Section {sectionNumber:'6.2.3'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH sec,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY t.tableNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: List the figures in section 5.3.4.1 of TS 38.509 (figure lookup).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.509'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(sec:Section {sectionNumber:'5.3.4.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH sec,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_FIGURE]->(f:TSFigure) RETURN f.figureId, f.figureNumber, f.figureCaption ORDER BY f.figureNumber LIMIT 15

question_en: Find which sections contain tables in TS 38.521-1 (table-to-section mapping).
cypher: MATCH (t:TSTable)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN t.tableId, sec.sectionId, sec.sectionTitle ORDER BY t.tableNumber, t.tableId LIMIT 5

question_en: List all tables in TS 38.523-1 (table inventory).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.523-1'}), (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY t.tableNumber, t.tableId LIMIT 25

question_en: Find sections of TS 38.533 whose title contains 'measurement' (topic search).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) WHERE toLower(s.sectionTitle) CONTAINS 'measurement' RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber, s.sectionId LIMIT 25

question_en: Locate the spec and section for tables numbered 6.2.x (table-number lookup).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec), (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) WHERE t.tableNumber STARTS WITH '6.2' RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionId, t.tableId LIMIT 10

question_en: List the level-2 sections of TS 38.521-2 (second-level outline).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section {level: 2})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-2'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber, s.sectionId LIMIT 25

question_en: List the subsections under section 7 of TS 38.523-1 (drilling into a clause).
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.523-1'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(p:Section {sectionNumber:'7'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH p,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(c:Section) RETURN c.sectionId, c.sectionNumber, c.sectionTitle ORDER BY c.sectionNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: List the void sections of TS 38.521-1 (identifying removed clauses).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section {isVoid: true})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: How many tables does TS 38.533 contain? (table count)
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}), (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN count(t) AS tableCount

question_en: List the level-3 sections of TS 38.533 (deep-outline browsing).
cypher: MATCH (s:Section {level: 3})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber, s.sectionId LIMIT 25

question_en: Which five RAN5 specs have the most sections? (largest specs)
cypher: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(s) AS sectionCount ORDER BY sectionCount DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: Which sections does section 6.5D.3.3.5 of TS 38.521-1 reference? (outgoing cross-references)
cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.521-1'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(a:Section {sectionNumber:'6.5D.3.3.5'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH a,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (a)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section) RETURN b.sectionId, b.sectionTitle ORDER BY b.sectionNumber LIMIT 25

question_en: Which ten sections are referenced most often? (most-cited clauses)
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section) WITH b, count(a) AS refCount RETURN b.sectionId, b.sectionTitle, refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which ten sections make the most outgoing references? (heaviest referrers)
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section) WITH a, count(b) AS outCount RETURN a.sectionId, outCount ORDER BY outCount DESC, a.sectionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Which spec-to-spec section-reference pairs are most frequent? (cross-spec coupling)
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sb:Spec) WHERE sa.specNumber <> sb.specNumber RETURN sa.specNumber AS fromSpec, sb.specNumber AS toSpec, count(*) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which five specs does TS 38.521-1 reference most? (dependency ranking)
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SPEC]->(target:Spec) RETURN target.specNumber, count(*) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC, target.specNumber LIMIT 5

question_en: Which ten spec-to-spec reference pairs are most frequent? (cross-spec dependencies)
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SPEC]->(sb:Spec) WHERE sa.specNumber <> sb.specNumber RETURN sa.specNumber AS fromSpec, sb.specNumber AS toSpec, count(*) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: How many internal cross-references does TS 38.533 contain? (self-reference density)
cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp) RETURN count(*) AS internalRefs

question_en: Which RAN5 specs do recent CRs modify? (change-to-spec mapping)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: For TS 38.521-1, report its CR count alongside its section total (change-and-structure summary).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.521-1'}) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub, count(cr) AS crCount MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub, crCount, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC WITH hub, crCount, collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCount, count(s) AS sectionCount

question_en: List the CRs that modify TS 38.521-1 (change-request survey).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: How many RAN5 CRs record the clauses they affect? (metadata completeness)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' RETURN count(cr) AS crCount

question_en: Which RAN5 specs does each company modify via CRs? (company spec impact)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN c.companyName, sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which RAN5 specs are modified by CRs that conclusions reference? (outcome-to-spec trace)
cypher: MATCH (res:Conclusion)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN res.resolutionId, t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber ORDER BY res.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the conclusions that reference CRs modifying TS 38.521-1 (decision provenance).
cypher: MATCH (res:Conclusion)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN res.resolutionId, t.tdocNumber ORDER BY res.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Per meeting, which RAN5 specs do approved CRs modify? (meeting-level spec impact)
cypher: MATCH (res:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting), (res)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' WITH m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, sp.specNumber AS spec, count(DISTINCT t) AS crCount RETURN meeting, spec, crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC, meeting, spec LIMIT 10

question_en: How many CRs do conclusions reference? (resolution-to-CR coverage)
cypher: MATCH (res:Conclusion)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc:CR) RETURN count(DISTINCT res) AS resCount, count(DISTINCT t) AS crCount

question_en: List all CRs changing TS 38.521-1 (comprehensive change survey).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Show each company's CR contributions per RAN5 spec (contribution matrix).
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' WITH c.companyName AS company, sp.specNumber AS spec, count(cr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC RETURN company, spec, cnt LIMIT 10

question_en: Which RAN5 specs were changed in each release? (release-level change map)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN rel.releaseName, sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which five RAN5 specs received the most CRs? (highest-churn specs)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 5

question_en: How many sections do RAN5 specs contain in total? (corpus size)
cypher: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN count(s) AS totalSections

question_en: How many tables do RAN5 specs contain in total? (table corpus size)
cypher: MATCH (t:TSTable)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN count(t) AS totalTables

question_en: How many figures do RAN5 specs contain in total? (figure corpus size)
cypher: MATCH (f:TSFigure)-[:FIGURE_IN_SECTION]->(sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN count(f) AS totalFigures

question_en: Count the item-level nodes for the five entity classes (RRCParameter, CapabilityItem, Procedure, PerformanceRequirement, ConformanceTest) (entity-layer inventory).
cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest'])   AND n.granularity = 'item' RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        count(n) AS items ORDER BY items DESC

question_en: Are all item-level entity nodes linked to a section via definedInSection? (link-coverage check)
cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest'])   AND n.granularity = 'item' WITH n, exists((n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section)) AS linked RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        count(n) AS total,        sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked,        round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(n), 1) AS link_pct

question_en: Show the granularity distribution across the five entity classes (item-level vs legacy section-level).
cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        coalesce(n.granularity, '<unset>') AS granularity,        count(n) AS c ORDER BY class, granularity

question_en: Do the baseline IEs (CodebookConfig-r16, LTM-Config-r18, BeamFailureRecoveryConfig, TCI-State) exist as RRCParameter nodes? (baseline presence check)
cypher: UNWIND ['CodebookConfig-r16','LTM-Config-r18','BeamFailureRecoveryConfig','TCI-State','TCI-UL-State-r17','RadioLinkMonitoringConfig'] AS expected OPTIONAL MATCH (ie:RRCParameter {ieName: expected}) RETURN expected, ie IS NOT NULL AS found, ie.specNumber AS spec, ie.release AS release

question_en: Are all 22 features from the feature catalog loaded as Feature nodes? (feature-catalog parity)
cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) RETURN count(f) AS feature_count, collect(f.featureId)[..30] AS feature_ids ORDER BY feature_count DESC

question_en: Give the reason-for-change of CR R5-261671 (change rationale).
cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R5-261671'}) RETURN c.reasonForChange AS reasonForChange LIMIT 1
gold_primary_values: In Table 7.3A.0.5-2, DL Fc of TDD band n77 used for CA_n40-n71-n77 does not match its UL Fc.

question_en: Give the summary-of-change of CR R5-261671 (change overview).
cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R5-261671'}) RETURN c.summaryOfChange AS summaryOfChange LIMIT 1
gold_primary_values: DL Fc of TDD band n77 used for CA_n40-n71-n77 was corrected in Table 7.3A.0.5-2 and Table 7.3A.2_1.4.1-1.

question_en: What are the consequences if CR R5-261671 is not approved? (approval-impact assessment)
cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R5-261671'}) RETURN c.consequencesIfNotApproved AS consequences LIMIT 1
gold_primary_values: CA_n40-n71-n77 will not be tested correctly.

question_en: List the other specs affected by CR R5-255419 (cross-spec impact).
cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) WHERE c.tdocNumber = 'R5-255419' RETURN c.tdocNumber, type(r) AS relType, s.specNumber ORDER BY s.specNumber

question_en: Which CRs modifying TS 38.521-1 also affect other specs? (ripple-effect screening)
cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() } RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: List the CRs that flag TS 38.533 as an affected spec (incoming impact).
cypher: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'})<-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Which ten CRs affect the most other specs? (broadest-impact ranking)
cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() WITH c, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, cnt

question_en: List the CRs in a CR pack with their change summaries (pack contents).
cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(c:CR) WITH pack, c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10 RETURN pack.crPackId AS crPackId, c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange AS summary

question_en: Which CR packs contain CRs for the 5GS_NR_LTE-UEConTest work items? (work-item pack lookup)
cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem) WHERE w.workItemCode CONTAINS '5GS_NR_LTE-UEConTest' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT pack.crPackId AS crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting AS tsgMeeting ORDER BY pack.tsgMeeting DESC, pack.crPackId LIMIT 10

question_en: List the ten largest CR packs by CR count (pack overview).
cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(cr:CR) RETURN pack.crPackId AS crPackId, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: Give the change reasons of CRs modifying section 6.2 of TS 38.521-1 (clause-level rationale).
cypher: MATCH (sec:Section {sectionNumber: '6.2'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) MATCH (sec)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason ORDER BY toInteger(replace(sp.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC, c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: For CRs referenced by a conclusion, give their change reason and summary (decision-linked rationale).
cypher: MATCH (con:Conclusion)-[:REFERENCES]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 5 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason, c.summaryOfChange AS summary

question_en: Which sections do the 5GS_NR_LTE-UEConTest CRs modify? (work-item clause impact)
cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem) WHERE w.workItemCode CONTAINS '5GS_NR_LTE-UEConTest' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(sec:Section) RETURN DISTINCT sec.sectionId AS sectionId ORDER BY sec.sectionId LIMIT 10

question_en: Which other specs do Samsung's CRs affect? (company cross-spec impact)
cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(comp:Company) WHERE comp.companyName CONTAINS 'Samsung' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber AS spec ORDER BY spec LIMIT 10

question_en: List the change summaries of CRs referenced by conclusions at meeting #87 (meeting-level change review).
cypher: MATCH (con:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumberInt: 87}) WITH con MATCH (con)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL RETURN t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, t.summaryOfChange AS summary ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: List all RAN5 technical reports with their status (TR inventory).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Return the scope of TR 38.903 (study-scope review).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.scope

question_en: Return the conclusions of TR 38.918 (study-outcome review).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.918'}) WHERE tr.conclusions IS NOT NULL RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.conclusions

question_en: List the technical reports marked Completed (finished-study survey).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) WHERE tr.trStatus = 'Completed' RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Which specs did TR 38.903 impact, and how? (study-to-spec impact)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType ORDER BY s.specNumber

question_en: Return the impact types and descriptions for TR 38.905 (impact classification).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.905'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription

question_en: Which TRs impacted specs by extending sections? (ExtendSection impact filter)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'ExtendSection'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: List the study-only TRs marked NoChange (no-spec-change studies).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'NoChange'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Which TRs impacted TS 38.521-1, and how? (incoming study impact)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Detail how TR 38.903 impacted each spec (full impact breakdown).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription ORDER BY s.specNumber

question_en: Detail how TR 38.905 impacted each spec (full impact breakdown).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.905'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription ORDER BY s.specNumber

question_en: Report the study findings of TR 38.918 (NoChange outcome).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.918'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription

question_en: List the TRs targeting Rel-19 (release-scoped studies).
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Which TRs impacted TS 38.521-1, with impact type? (spec-impact lookup)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType ORDER BY tr.trNumber

question_en: Which TRs impacted TS 38.533, with impact type? (spec-impact lookup)
cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType ORDER BY tr.trNumber
